question: What share of children due for immunisation were fully immunised in each district?

insights.message: The data shows how coverage differs between districts but cannot explain why one district outperforms another.

view.title: District immunisation coverage
view.note: Each bar shows the percentage of children fully immunised out of those due, for a given district and year. Use the year selector above to focus on one year at a time.

interpretation_guard.caveat: Differences between districts may reflect many factors not captured in this table, such as staffing, outreach reach, or population mobility.
